Global gateway fairness: two fixture projects autorunning against one fake endpoint share the queue fairly; total-berth governor enforced (FR-F3)

tickets.title: Kanban board UI (verb-driven, refusal explanations)

tickets.title: Artifact viewer + receipt inspector
acceptance: Markdown + client-side Mermaid + per-ticket live diffs (CodeMirror) with version history (FR-C3); receipt/coverage/challenge/ledger structured views (FR-C5); artifact/receipt empty states per UX_SPEC §2b

Inline feedback comments on any deliverable incl. rendered Mermaid; comment -> revision.requested event; revised version renders as diff against the commented version with the comment resolved-by-reference (FR-C8, R-H2)

tickets.title: Settings UI: matrix, autonomy dial, budgets, berths, scopes
acceptance: Model matrix editor with fitness-card surfacing (W2-08); autonomy dial with immutable NEVER-AUTO list displayed; budget panel; berths slider; effective-settings 'why this value' resolution view (FR-S1); first-run wizard preset->provider->forge->sample (FR-S4)

Settings covers the full FR-S1 project scope: MCP server registration + per-role tool allowlists UI (FR-I3 surface), validator-pack selection, and expert overrides/additions management (FR-E1) — not just the model matrix (design review G-19)
Rule-lifecycle admin surface (D-014): per-rule state, measured FP rate + window, promotion/demotion actions (human-confirmed, data shown), suppression review list with justifications
Escalation-policy setting UI (D-018): per-role ladder/locked/token-gated with tier picker and the effective-policy why-this-value view; in-product help affordances rendered from content/guide/ (R-M1)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 design review G-19. AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted D-014). AMENDED 2026-07-14 addendum (D-018, R-M1). Also FR-RL2 + FR-RL3 surfaces (promotion/demotion data view, suppression review).

tickets.title: Notification center: Decide/Review/Record + aggregated morning queue
acceptance: Emitters declare a tier; Record never pops; Review batches into digests; Decide promotes to push only when idle-blocked (FR-N4); morning queue aggregates across projects, sorted by leverage, per-project filters (FR-F4); ten-minute-review target documented in docs/design/UX_SPEC.md honored in card design
Quiet hours respected for push (Decide queues, run continues under auto policy); empty states per docs/design/UX_SPEC.md §2b for queue + notification center
Trust-graduation suggestion: Record-tier card when evidence thresholds cross (>=10 clean closes, 0 oscillations, 0 unwaived criticals over 7d, >=2 lanes) citing its evidence (R-A1, US-310)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 design review G-18. AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted R-A1).

tickets.title: Dry-run cost estimate
acceptance: Pre-autorun estimate from ticket points x role matrix x historical per-ticket actuals, with per-wave breakdown and what-if on matrix changes (BLUEPRINT §12.2)
Escalation-ROI view: spend grouped by rung per ticket with outcome, over GET /spend?group_by=rung; weekly Review-tier digest card (R-A2, US-309)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted R-A2). Cites FR-G7 (dry-run estimate).

tickets.title: Global registry DB (~/.shipwright/global.db) + fitness persistence + fit-guard wiring (G-9)
acceptance: ~/.shipwright/global.db created per DATABASE.md §7 (projects, providers, global_playbook, model_fitness) with the same WAL/single-writer/migration discipline as state.db; Fleet project cards read stats live from each project DB, never cached here

FitnessCardStore persists to model_fitness keyed (model, role, harness_version); guardFitAssignment is called inside routing route() so an unfit/marginal assignment warns structurally (W2-08 HANDOFF closed)

tickets.title: Agent roster & observability view (FR-E2, R-K1)
acceptance: Roster lists every content/ expert: cluster, mode, description, effective model resolution with winning scope (FR-S1 style), fitness cards per configured model (W2-08), instruction-cost metadata (FR-L8)

Per-agent history queried from events (HANDOFFs run, outcomes, verdict scores, spend, escalations) — matches a projection rebuild (test); content loader refuses an expert file with a hardcoded frontier model id (pin roles, not models)
tickets.notes: ADDED 2026-07-14 addendum (adopted by founder direction, R-K1/FR-E2).

tickets.title: Phase machine + gate receipts + waiver flow
acceptance: Six phases with per-phase validator sets; receipts + two-way prereq re-verification (FR-P1/P2); human-signed waiver receipts; edits to deliverables invalidate downstream receipts visibly (FR-P3)

Mermaid-parse validator in every phase validator set (broken diagram cannot gate-pass, R-H3); revision.requested events from artifact feedback (FR-C8) route a revision HANDOFF to the producing role and invalidate downstream receipts per FR-P3
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 addendum (R-H2/R-H3). Cites FR-G5: soft-gate waivers permitted phases 0-3 only, build/verify gates never soften — waiver semantics live in the phase machine.

tickets.title: Discovery interview (phases 0-2)
acceptance: Adaptive-depth interview drives VISION/SCOPE/personas/SRS/stories drafts through chat cards; deliverables editable in the artifact viewer; interview is NEVER-AUTO (NA-1 heritage)

tickets.title: Decision slates + DECISIONS ledger
acceptance: Slate cards: 2-4 options, trade-offs, recommended default; choice + rationale appends to docs/DECISIONS.md with stable D-IDs; agents hitting a founder-owned fork must emit a slate, never assume (FR-P6); downstream docs cite D-IDs

Technical-fork slates use the design-options discipline: exactly 3 options (Minimal/Clean/Pragmatic) compared on 6 fixed dimensions (time, maintainability, scalability, team-fit, risk, reversibility), recommendation tied to a named constraint; founder forks keep the free 2-4 format (R-H1)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 addendum (R-H1).

tickets.title: Blueprint stage (Phase 2.5) + decision-complete gate
acceptance: Synthesizes BLUEPRINT.md (condensed SRS + architecture + open questions) from phase 0-2 deliverables; revision loop via slates; Phases 3-4 locked while unresolved founder-decision markers remain (FR-P7); the gate is a validator with red fixtures

tickets.title: Research path: depths, citations, fact bank, challenger wiring
acceptance: quick/standard/deep research runs producing cited reports in docs/research/ (tiered sources, per-claim citations); HIGH-impact claims require a Challenger verdict before a decision may cite them; confirmed findings enter the R0 fact bank (FR-P8)
Phase 0 market, Phase 1 feasibility, Phase 3 design-options + build-vs-adopt, Phase 4 pre-code API verification templates shipped as content

tickets.title: Challenger service (reports, verdicts, revision handoffs)
acceptance: CHALLENGE_REPORT artifacts with per-claim CONFIRMED/CONTRADICTED/UNVERIFIABLE; citation-less challenges discarded (downgrade to UNVERIFIABLE, never CONTRADICTED); CONTRADICTED forces revision HANDOFF (FR-P4); challenger model must differ from maker model (W2-05); tool-call cap per claim

Challenger/reviewer verdicts follow the asymmetric threshold (score >=7 accept, 5-6 bounded polish, 1-4 escalate-to-human — never auto-fail over a passing deterministic gate) and every verdict carries the re-ran independently evidence line (R-B2, FR-L6)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted R-B2).

tickets.title: Task decomposer (design -> ticket DAG)
acceptance: Design docs -> typed ticket DAG with lanes derived from write-scope disjointness, acceptance criteria, executable verify per ticket; human can edit the DAG before build; DAG renders as mermaid in the artifact viewer (BLUEPRINT §4 step 4)

Seam lessons (field report §10): when a ticket's deliverable imports a workspace sibling, its write_scope MUST include that package's package.json (dependency declaration); every consumed cross-ticket interface has an owning ticket for the public re-export (no invisible exports — the W1-02 class); both are plan-linter checks emitted with the DAG
notes: AMENDED 2026-07-12: +seam-ownership acceptance from conductor field report §10 (W0-08/W1-02 lessons).

tickets.title: Modes: Onboard / Feature / Improve
acceptance: Onboard maps an existing repo (landscape, entry points, components, health) using imported onboard specialists; Feature runs a scoped mini-program; Improve produces an audit + fix backlog as tickets (FR-P5)
Macro coverage-loop caps are mode-aware: 3 for New Product/Onboard, 2 for Feature/Improve (source RALPH_WIGGUM_LOOP; R-B5); byte-identical gap-set early-halt applies in every mode
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted R-B5).

tickets.title: Guided first-15-minutes sample project
acceptance: Built-in sample idea runs the full program in miniature (interview -> blueprint -> slates -> board -> morning queue) on the user's cheapest configured model; completes < 15 min on a local model; wired as the last step of the first-run wizard (BLUEPRINT §12.3, FR-S4)
Every major surface carries a ? help affordance opening task-oriented guide content (content/guide/, data not code); wizard ends with a what-to-do-tomorrow card (R-M1)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 addendum (R-M1). Cites FR-C6 (the guided sample IS FR-C6).

tickets.title: Improvement Plans: recommendation catalog + engine + nightly auto-verify (FR-PLAN1-3, D-016)
acceptance: Versioned deterministic catalog (content/plan-catalog, data not code): entries {id, condition over receipts/coverage/finding-ledger snapshots, recommendation template, machine-checkable verify criterion}; evaluation over a fixture snapshot is byte-stable and produces exactly the expected plan items (FR-PLAN1)

plan_items lifecycle proposed/accepted/in_progress/done/regressed per DATABASE.md §5b; deterministic ranking (severity x leverage x staleness, property-tested); accepting an item mints a board ticket carrying the item verify (FR-PLAN2)

Nightly auto-verify re-evaluates accepted items against fresh snapshots, flips done/regressed, emits Review-tier notifications on regression; zero Decide pops (FR-PLAN3); no code path passes LLM output into item creation (FR-PLAN4, lint/type-level gate)
tickets.notes: ADDED 2026-07-14 (adopted AM-4/R-C1, D-016). Design: docs/design/IMPROVEMENT_PLANS.md.

tickets.title: Improvement Plans UI: plan view + morning-queue integration (FR-PLAN2/4, D-016)
acceptance: Plan view renders ranked items with catalog provenance, verify criterion, state, and linked ticket; accept/dismiss actions; fully functional with the gateway disabled (FR-PLAN4)
Regressed items surface in the morning queue as Review cards with the violated criterion + evidence; funnel counts (raw findings -> plan items -> accepted -> done/regressed) shown per FR-RL4 style
tickets.notes: ADDED 2026-07-14 (adopted AM-4/R-C1, D-016). NOTE: write_scope overlaps W4-01 apps/web/** cross-lane — resolved by the P5 scope surgery narrowing W4-01 (D-015 note).

tickets.title: Forge framework + GitHub adapter (PRs, protection, webhooks)
acceptance: Adapter contract: repo ops, branch protection setup on connect (reviewer!=author, no force-push, required checks), PR lifecycle, issue mirror, commit status, identity/token mgmt (FR-I1); recorded-fixture contract tests
tickets.notes: Adapter contract: docs/design/CONTRACTS.md §2.

tickets.title: Gitea adapter + generic git fallback
acceptance: Gitea passes the same contract suite; generic SSH-git fallback degrades gracefully (no PRs/issues -> local merge path + explicit capability flags) (FR-I2)

tickets.title: Forge mirror: per-identity write-through + reconciliation
acceptance: Two machine identities provisioned (maker/reviewer) with separate scoped tokens; reviewer token held only by Harbormaster, never in agent env (docs/SECURITY_CONTROLS.md); verbs write through (claim=assign+label, evidence=comment, close=state+receipt comment, accept=reviewer comment) (FR-T5)
Offline queue in ticket history flushes when reachable; reconciliation audit grades tickets VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED/ORPHAN against issues + git history, two-way drift report
tickets.notes: NOTE 2026-07-14 (G-21): machine accounts + scoped tokens are human prerequisites HP-5/HP-6 — docs/PREREQUISITES.md; the connect flow blocks with evidence naming the HP id when absent.

tickets.title: MCP host (per-role allowlists, approval flags, audited calls)
acceptance: Register MCP servers per project; per-role tool allowlists; requiresApproval flags (dynamic for shell) route through the approval card flow; every tool call is an event with args digest + cost (FR-I3); servers run outside the agent trust boundary — core executes calls under policy

tickets.title: Dual-remote sync + parity validator
acceptance: Push to N remotes with per-remote status; parity validator flags SHA divergence as a red hygiene state that blocks next claim (amplifier hole 11, docs/research/source-system-amplifier.md)

tickets.title: Execution sandbox (process default, container profile)
acceptance: Verify/test runs execute in the worktree under a restricted process (no network by default, opt-in per project); optional Podman/Docker profile; sandbox results are what receipts attest to (FR-I4)

tickets.title: Content pack signing + first-party re-sign (G-4d / SC-09)
acceptance: Pack manifest carries file hashes + publisher-key signature; install/load verifies signature + hash tree and records provenance; unsigned or mismatched packs load only behind --allow-unsigned with a permanent Settings warning badge (SC-09)
First-party imported content is signed (re-sign at the v2.1.0+ resync, SW-R1); tampered-pack red fixture refused in the planted-defect harness

Content intake is license-gated deny-by-default: pack manifests carry a REQUIRED license field; only MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/first-party auto-accepted, anything else parks as a founder slate (R-E1; CODE_HEALTH_SUITE §8 provenance pattern)
tickets.notes: ADDED 2026-07-14 design review G-4d: SC-09 claimed W1 signing that never happened and no ticket owned it. Community install flow UI remains post-1.0 (S-42) — this is the mechanism + first-party signing only. AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted R-E1). Enforces NFR-5 (plug-in surfaces + signed packs; contracts in docs/design/CONTRACTS.md).

tickets.title: Memory service: working + long-term (FTS5, budgeted assembly)
acceptance: Per-project working memory (findings, calibration) + long-term store (facts, error->solution pairs, decisions) with FTS5 + optional local embeddings, token-budgeted assembly, BM25 fallback (FR-M1); loop memory hooks wired in packages/loop from day one — a test proves recall fires in a micro-loop run (the anti-Jarvis-gap test, docs/research/source-system-foreman-jarvis.md §5); Completion Manifest schema carries memory_written[] and the Harbormaster truth-check treats a missing/empty field on memory-eligible roles as a gap (R-G2, the v2.5.0 library lesson: 44/45 agents silently skipped write-back until it was manifest-gated)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 addendum (R-G2).

tickets.title: Playbook (ACE deltas, verified-before-stored) + R0 advisor + global promotion
acceptance: Delta-edit-only playbook; only tool/challenger-confirmed outcomes stored (FR-M2); R0 escalation rung consults playbook + fact bank before any model call, with hit/miss events; per-project by default, explicit provenance-carrying promotion to the global playbook, never automatic (FR-F5)

tickets.title: Sleep consolidation + error-first recall
acceptance: Scheduled idle-hours job: dedupe, decay, consolidate, pre-brief the morning queue; ON by default (FR-M3); before a task class that previously failed, the failure fact + fix inject first (error-first recall), test-proven

tickets.title: Context packer (relevance ranking, core block, stable prefix)
acceptance: Token-budgeted packets: relevance-ranked file slices (never naive truncation), repo-map skeleton, pinned core block <=1k tokens, stable-prefix ordering for KV-cache hits (BLUEPRINT §7.2); budget scales with model window; HANDOFF assembly switches to the packer

Token envelopes per FR-L8: per-window budget table (32k: 8/20/28k, 60k: 15/38/54k, 100k+: 25/65/90k instruction/working/emergency), write-before-reading-more (>500-token tool results to disk, referenced), emergency stop -> honest PARTIAL, per-expert instruction-cost accounting; prune failed-attempt turns from packets (R-I1/R-I2); ranking source = W7-06 code index (FR-M4)
tickets.notes: NOTE 2026-07-14: context-packet assembly must call the W3-13 redaction layer on every packet (SC-06) — acceptance implied by BLUEPRINT §7.2 + FR-L5. AMENDED 2026-07-14 addendum (FR-L8, R-I1/I2, R-J1 dep).

tickets.title: Lessons intake -> playbook pipeline
acceptance: Structured field-report form (from a user or the trace viewer); triage flow turns accepted reports into playbook entries or validator-fix tickets (BLUEPRINT §12.6); entry points: "File field report" action on session-trace views and escalation event cards, form pre-filled from the trace (UX_SPEC §7, G-10c)
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 design review G-10c.

tickets.title: Code-index service + code_search tool (FR-M4, R-J1)
acceptance: Chunked per-project code index (SQLite FTS5 + optional local embeddings, same engine as facts); code_search(query, top_k, path_filter) returns ranked chunks with file:line; provider-sticky embeddings with BM25 fallback on provider mismatch or offline (NFR-1); ripgrep wrapper for exact search
Context Packer consumes index ranking for relevance-ranked slices (FR-L5); agent code_search calls are audited events; W4 command palette queries the same index
tickets.notes: ADDED 2026-07-14 addendum (adopted by founder direction, R-J1/FR-M4). No repo-map by design (source-system lesson).

tickets.title: Dogfood gate: Shipwright runs its own pipeline on itself
acceptance: Onboard mode over this repo produces a health assessment; security cluster + threat-model refresh run via the platform itself; findings become tickets on this board; the run's receipts/coverage published under docs/dogfood/ (the 1.0 gate, BLUEPRINT §9 W8)

The dogfood security/code-health run asserts the FULL imported rule set executes (all 30 anti-slop rules + all 66 validators enumerated in the coverage report — the name-ALL-of-the-set lesson, R-E3); shadow/advisory/gate states honored per D-014
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 (adopted R-E3).

tickets.title: Session trace viewer
acceptance: Replay any agent session from its events: prompt, tool calls, gate results per pass; linked from ticket cards; feeds the lessons form (BLUEPRINT §12.4)

tickets.title: Board export/import bundle
acceptance: Board + receipts + ledgers serialize to a portable JSON bundle; import reconstructs projections and verifies the hash chain (BLUEPRINT §12.8)

tickets.title: Packaging: npx entry, config dirs, upgrade migrations
acceptance: npx shipwright boots the server + opens the canvas; ~/.shipwright/ + per-project .shipwright/ created per docs/DEPLOYMENT.md; event-log schema migrations run on upgrade with backup-first; macOS/Linux verified, WSL smoke-tested (D-009)

Boot sequence per DEPLOYMENT §8 verified: migrations → orphan sweep → audit fast tail-check; high-water event seq mirrored to ~/.shipwright/ per project (SC-11) with a test that a truncated log is detected on next boot
tickets.notes: AMENDED 2026-07-14 design review G-22. Verifies NFR-7 (macOS/Linux + WSL smoke).

tickets.title: Ops lifecycle: doctor, backup+retention, restore drill, service install, providers refresh (G-5)
acceptance: shipwright backup performs SQLite online backup (VACUUM INTO) with daily-copy retention default 7 and prunes .shipwright/backups; shipwright doctor checks port, DB integrity + chain tail, keychain access, provider reachability, pack signatures, worktree orphans (DEPLOYMENT §8)
Restore drill EXECUTED as a test: back up a seeded project, corrupt the live DB, restore, audit verify green — the drill is a named CI test, not a doc promise
shipwright service install|status|stop generates launchd/systemd user units (DEPLOYMENT §6); shipwright providers refresh re-runs discovery/warm-up
tickets.notes: ADDED 2026-07-14 design review G-5: DEPLOYMENT.md promised all of these with zero owning tickets.

tickets.title: Human-edit conflict policy: leases, watcher, human-wins re-ground (FR-T6)
acceptance: File watcher on the human checkout flags edits inside an actively-leased write-scope -> conflict.detected event; affected loop checkpoints at its next pass boundary; agent worktree rebases onto the human change and the micro-loop re-grounds (criterion + evidence re-evaluated) — human always wins (FR-T6, UC-04)
Material rebase conflict parks the ticket blocked: human-edit-conflict with a Decide card (take mine / take agent's / merge view); human edits are attributed events credited in coverage
Leased paths surfaced to the UI (lock badge data, UX_SPEC §4)
